note: The candidate was read in full and findings recorded independently. Host equivalents allowed by D were accepted; actual peripheral dependencies were not treated as failures.
scope_review_policy: R+D host-equivalent scope; configuration stubs allowed but required values and observable data paths must exist; Direct not penalized using unsupplied A; C equivalents for assembly accepted under D:72.

release_export.language: Original Chinese evidence/rationales retained; no semantic translation.
release_export.preservation: Initial verdicts, reasons, historical rates and human-review flags retained. Path anonymization and export metadata do not constitute a new review.
release_export.current_aggregation: (fully_covered + partially_covered) / preclassified static denominator; no fractional weighting of partial items.
release_export.evidence_line_numbers: Original candidate lines; transformed candidate comments, where used, retain separately recorded original and distributed hashes.
